title: AgentProvider label contract
description: Keys are proto enum value names; the generator cross-checks them against the AgentProvider enum from `buf build` (every non-UNSPECIFIED value exactly once). The reverse parse map is displayName + cliAlias + parseAliases per provider, so the CLI alias always round-trips.

supportsSessionGoal.description: Whether this provider's CLI has a session goal at all. It decides only whether the Goals & To-dos section offers a goal card; the live supported_actions list the worker broadcasts still governs every control.
